from src.inference.semantic_response_ssm import fixed_driver_response,fit_fixed_driver_response

from src.inference.t3a_balloon_robust_ssm import BalloonParameters
p=BalloonParameters();n=120;t=np.arange(n)*.25
basis=equal_capacity_hb_basis(np.eye(3*n),modes=4).reshape(n,3,4)[:,1:]
mask=np.zeros((n,2),bool);mask[:40]=True
summary={tol:[] for tol in [1e-6,1e-8]}
for seed in range(4):
 rng=np.random.default_rng(seed)
 driver=.025*np.sin(t/(1+seed*.3))+.01*np.exp(-((t-6)/3)**2)
 initial=np.array([.003,1.02,1.015,1.015,1.005])
 for lag,visc in [(0.,0.),(1.,0.),(0.,3.)]:
  truth=fixed_driver_response(driver,p,.25,initial_state=initial,tau_n=lag,tau_v=visc)['prediction']
  target=truth+np.einsum('tck,k->tc',basis,rng.normal(size=4)*.015)+rng.normal(size=(n,2))*.006
  for tol in summary:
   start=time.monotonic();f=fit_fixed_driver_response(target,driver,p,.25,sd=.006,visible=mask,hb_basis=basis,initial_mode='tied_pv_logprior',initial_prior_sd=[.1,.3,.3,.3],component_sd=.025,gradient_tolerance=tol,tau_n=lag,tau_v=visc,max_nfev=120)
   row=dict(seed=seed,tau_n=lag,tau_v=visc,status=f['status'],reason=f['convergence_reason'],nfev=f['evaluations'],gradient=f['scaled_gradient_inf_norm'],seconds=time.monotonic()-start,objective=f['objective'])
   summary[tol].append(row)
   if not f['success']:print('failure',tol,row)
for tol,rows in summary.items():
 print('summary',tol,dict(cells=len(rows),successful=sum(r['status']=='completed' for r in rows),nfev_median=np.median([r['nfev'] for r in rows]),nfev_max=max(r['nfev'] for r in rows),gradient_max=max(r['gradient'] for r in rows),time_median=np.median([r['seconds'] for r in rows]),time_max=max(r['seconds'] for r in rows])))
print('max objective delta',max(abs(a['objective']-b['objective']) for a,b in zip(summary[1e-6],summary[1e-8])))
